title: Agent Core: Types, State Machine, Event Bus, Control Queue
description:
Implement foundational agent types and infrastructure from docs/plans/05-agent.md.

Sections: §2 (Architecture), §3 (Types), §3.1 (Session), §3.2 (AgentDriver), §3.3 (AgentTool), §3.4 (AgentEvent), §5 (State Machine + Event Bus + Control Queue), §6 (Concurrency Model)

Key deliverables:
- Agent, Session, AgentState, AgentMessage, AgentEvent types (types.go)
- AgentDriver interface and registry/factory (driver.go)
- AgentTool struct with Execute callback (types.go)
- State machine with all transitions: Idle/Streaming/ToolExecution/WaitingFollowUp/Exited (agent.go)
- Event bus with fan-out, subscriber isolation, panic recovery (event_bus.go)
- Control queue for steer/follow-up/abort serialization (control_queue.go)
- Typed errors: busy, stopped, invalid-state (errors.go)
- SessionMetrics instrumentation
- Unit tests for all of the above

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §1.4 (AgentDriver), §1.5 (AgentTool), §2.1 (Lifecycle Ordering), §5 (Seam Reference Table)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/05-agent.md §2-§6
- Test harness: docs/plans/05-agent-test-harness.md
- Depends on: Batch 1+2 core types (internal/ai)
